next.reason: 1985: 'If an exception condition which is not an invalid key condition exists, control is transferred according to the rules of the USE statement following the execution of any USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure' (§1985:IX.1.3.5). 2023: 'If the I-O status indicates an unsuccessful completion that is not an invalid key condition' control goes to the applicable exception processing statements (§2023:9.1.14), which include the USE declarative (§2023:9.1.12 GR2); the USE procedure runs 'upon the unsuccessful execution of an input-output operation' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR6) and then 'control is returned to an implicit CONTINUE statement following the input-output statement' or, if fatal, as the implementor determines (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR7), as 1985 USE did; READ restates it (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR13). Exception-checking PERFORM is 2023-only syntax. Same control flow.
